description: This file implements CLI commands for managing MCP servers within an AgentField project, including starting, stopping, restarting, viewing logs, managing skills, discovering capabilities, migrating configurations, and removing servers. It uses Cobra for command-line interface structure and interacts with internal packages for configuration, MCP management, and capability discovery.

classes.name: MCPCapability
classes.description: Represents the capabilities of an MCP server, including server metadata, tools, and resources.

methods.name: displayServerCapability
methods.description: Displays detailed information about an MCP server's capabilities, including tools and resources.
